name: approvalmax
description: Access ApprovalMax companies, users, Xero-sourced bills and purchase orders, and standalone approval documents via the myHub-hosted ApprovalMax MCP gateway. OAuth-based — no API keys.

connection.instructions: Click Connect and sign in to your ApprovalMax account. myHub handles the OAuth handshake and token refresh automatically. You'll need to pick which company/organisation to work with when using this connector's tools, since ApprovalMax accounts can span multiple companies.
